🏆 Showdown complete

How to play Table Showdown

  1. Choose Picture Peek, Riddle Round, Double Dish, or X-ray & Flashlight. In scan mode, move your finger or pointer across the picture to reveal parts of the food. Set the optional five-second answer clock and tap Start Game.
  2. Wait for the whole clue. Tap your team’s buzzer or press A for Maple or L for Pumpkin. The first team to buzz answers aloud.
  3. The teacher selects Correct to serve one dish and score one point. In Double Dish, name both foods in one sentence, in either order.
  4. Choose Try the Other Team after a miss. The timer also passes the turn when it expires. Each team gets one try. Reveal Answer ends the clue without a point.
  5. Tap Next Clue. Four points wins. If the deck runs out, the higher score wins. A tie goes to a fresh clue until a team scores.
